objective: Mean per-query mean hard-negative pairwise logistic loss + lambda/2 * squared parameter norm. Six bounded additive deltas around exact baseline Float total.
candidatePolicy: Freeze baseline winning path for each of up to 255 Chinese texts; use baseline top 8 other texts as negatives, no target-guided path changes.
selection: Among models with strictly higher dev top1 and dev top5 >= baseline, maximize dev top1, then top5, then MRR, then stronger regularization. Otherwise retain baseline and do not claim a candidate promotion.
testGate: Higher aggregate Chinese fixed-pool top1 and no aggregate top5 loss; no first-count loss in either full-sentence or midpoint-editor mode. List every first/rank loss regardless of aggregate.
boundaries: Offline only. Positive source priors, correction calibration, personal features, spelling graph, dictionary and LM stay unchanged. Personal entries are excluded from this empty-store training. No APK promotion from this gate alone.
